name: Chaos Rituals
notes: Used by Magisters and other Chaos casters. Cast as a Shoot/Spell action, 2d6 equal to or over the difficulty. Each caster starts with one spell rolled on a d12 and may learn more; a duplicate is re-rolled or its difficulty lowered by 1. Judgement call: text taken from the group's rules doc, already converted to d12.

spells.name: Vision of Torment
spells.text: Range 6". Must target the closest enemy model; in melee, a model in base contact with the caster. The target is stunned. If it cannot be stunned, it is knocked down.

spells.name: Eye of God
spells.text: Once per battle. Choose one model, friend or enemy, within 6" and roll a d12: 1-2, it is out of action (no Serious Injury roll after the battle); 3-10, +1 to one characteristic of the caster's choice for the battle; 11-12, +1 to all its characteristics for the battle.

spells.name: Dark Blood
spells.text: Range 8". D3 S10 hits on the first model in its path. Then roll on the Injury chart for the caster; treat out of action as stunned.

spells.name: Lure of Chaos
spells.text: Range 12". Must target the closest enemy model. Each side rolls d12 + its model's Leadership. If the caster scores higher, he controls the target until it passes a Leadership test in its own Recovery phase. It cannot be made to harm itself and will not attack the caster's warband. If it was in melee with the caster's warband, both sides move 1" apart.

spells.name: Wings of Darkness
spells.text: The caster moves up to 12" anywhere. If he ends in base contact with an enemy he counts as charging. If he contacts a Broken enemy he scores one automatic hit, then that enemy keeps fleeing if it survives.

spells.name: Word of Pain
spells.text: Every model within 3" of the caster, friend or enemy, suffers one S6 hit. No armour saves.
